integrity: The proof is symbolic: three loops at one vertex force a same-parity pair whose transposition leaves the matrix-unit product unchanged, so there are at most two loops per vertex; counting then gives the sharp lower bound. The focal full text was inspected at the finite-level theorem and its matrix-unit proof.
scientific_limitations: The lower bound is exact only for parity-isolating loop-chain, single-entry Fourier extraction schemes with one forward edge between successive matrix vertices and all remaining labels loops. It does not establish the globally minimal contractivity level.
title: Sharp matrix-size lower bound for loop-chain extraction at even exponents
